testcases.name: cdp.zookeeper.zk_migration.test_zk_migration.ZookeeperMigrationTest.test_zk_migration_source_zk_monitor_died
testcases.summary: Currently the zk migration is tested when zookeeper service crashes/dies/killed on either the zk leader/follower svm. In tickets, https://jira.nutanix.com/browse/ENG-642107 we have seen cases where zookeeper monitor was killed and migration was initiated. The test wants to ensure that in such scenarios we do not have service crashes, quorum is maintained, zk read and write operations and connections to zk server can be made without any errors. As part of this test we will cover two scenarios namely kill zk_monitor and other kill monitor for zk monitor and zk monitor.

testcases.name: cdp.zookeeper.zk_scalability.test_zk_scalability.ZookeeperScalability.test_zk_high_zk_nodes_count
testcases.summary: This test creates 300k zk nodes in batch of 100k and performs zk migration. It ensures that we are successfully able to create 300k nodes without hitting OOM error. The test case intends to catch issues like ENG-566675 where size of datatree increases due to multiple copies. We wanted to ensure that we can create an expected number of nodes without hitting errors. We have seen in ENG-566067, that about 200k are sufficient for filling zookeeper memory due to bug fixed in https://gerrit.eng.nutanix.com/#/c/main/+/773878 As far as the current design goes, we believe that 300k nodes is sufficient. Later curator can delete unused nodes aggressively. https://gerrit.eng.nutanix.com/#/c/main/+/776977/

testcases.name: cdp.zookeeper.zk_scalability.test_zk_scalability.ZookeeperScalability.test_zk_sessions_at_scale
testcases.summary: The purpose of this test is multifold. 1. Verify aos for max number of connections a zookeeper server can sustain. We currently have the limit of zookeeper_max_client_cnxns (default 300) connections to zookeeper servers from one host. The zk team wants to test and qualify zk server for large sessions limit citing the tickets and efforts on 48 node cluster. Currently it is increased to 600 (for 6.8 and 6.9 only) https://gerrit.eng.nutanix.com/#/c/main/+/863677/, generally it is 300. Ex. For 40 node cluster, test should create 300*40 = 12000 sessions. 2. Verify the zk migration op when sessions are connected. 3. Checking that no client requests are dropped.
